title: Power
target: Compare how quickly energy is transferred.
criteria: Distinguish energy in J from power in W.
Explain equal work done at different rates.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.guide: A watt is one joule per second.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A machine transfers 120 J in total. Which additional measurement is needed for average power?
cpa.guide: Average power is total energy transferred divided by elapsed time.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

cpa.prompt: A motor transfers 144 J in 8 s. What is average power?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A 35 W device transfers energy steadily for 6 s. How much energy is transferred?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: Two motors each transfer 200 J. A takes 5 s and B takes 10 s. Compare average powers.
options: A transfers twice as much energy.
cpa.guide: A = 40 W; B = 20 W, while total energy is equal.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.

cpa.prompt: A faster lift raises the same load through the same height with unchanged efficiency. What can increase while useful work stays the same?
options: The height must decrease to zero.
The load’s gravitational energy gain must double.
cpa.guide: Same work in less time means greater average power.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
